title.narrative: Powering the Future with the European Green Deal: Clean, Affordable and Secure Electricity for All

description.narrative:
Overall objective of this action is set to facilitate further involvement and participation of electrical energy ecosystem actors in Türkiye, in order to support Türkiye¿s commitments to the thematic area of ¿Supplying Clean, Affordable and Secure Energy¿ of The European Green Deal (EGD).

Specific objectives of the action are the following:

-    Objective 1: To improve operational and institutional capacity of ELDER in order to ensure development and piloting of innovative solutions and actions regarding electricity distribution system in line with the European Green Deal strategic priorities with considering electricity generation and consumption.

-     Objective 2: To facilitate further participation and advocacy capacity in decision making processes of the electricity and energy sector at-large, in realisation of strategic goals set in ¿Türkiye¿s Green Deal Action Plan¿ for energy sector and other relevant strategic initiatives.

-     Objective 3: To disseminate information and raise awareness of industrial stakeholders and general public/citizens with a focus on Youth, regarding benefits and consequences of adoption of European Green Deal measures in generation, distribution and consumption of electricity.

Objective 4: To build lasting partnerships and alliances with Turkish and European actors who are working to realize European Green Deal goals in the energy and electricity sectors.


The project is awarded under the call for proposal that aims to support the improvement of the capacities of civil society organisations towards the achievement of the ambitious targets of the European Green Deal.
